about: Stock HyperVault tokens for native clients, read from app/globals.css (and, for the card-brand colours, components/vault-pane/vault-tile.tsx). 'schema' says what each key holds. lib/__tests__/brand-tokens.test.ts fails on drift, and the code wins.

schema.source: string. The CSS file the stock values are read from.
schema.stock.mode: "dark" or "light". Which the stock look is; the test derives it from the luminance of background and foreground.
schema.stock.color: object. Token name (the CSS custom property without '--') to "#rrggbb". Every hex colour in :root, which is also every colour @theme inline maps to Tailwind.
schema.stock.radius: object. Token name to a CSS length, verbatim. 'radius' is from :root; 'radius-xl', 'radius-2xl' and 'radius-3xl' are calc() offsets of it from @theme inline.
schema.stock.radiusPx: object. The same keys as stock.radius, resolved to a number of CSS px at 1rem = 16px (1 CSS px = 1 iOS pt).
schema.stock.shadow: object. Token name to a CSS box-shadow, verbatim, from :root.
schema.stock.shadowLayers: object. The same keys as stock.shadow, parsed into layers in CSS order (the first layer paints on top). Each layer: x, y, blur and spread in px; color "#rrggbb"; opacity 0 to 1; inset true or false.
schema.stock.font: object. Token name to a CSS font-family stack, verbatim. 'font-sans' is from @theme inline; 'font-mono' and 'font-serif' are from :root. No web font is loaded, so each stack resolves to a font the device already has.
schema.fixed: object. Name to a CSS colour, verbatim. Colours drawn outside the tokens, so no theme changes them: the code panel (.hv-doc-panel in app/globals.css) and the card-brand tiles (components/vault-pane/vault-tile.tsx). 'card-mastercard-left' and 'card-mastercard-right' are the two discs on the Mastercard tile; the right one is drawn at 90% opacity.
schema.themes: array, in lib/themes.ts order. Each entry: id (styleId), className (the wrapper class) and mode. Their palettes stay in app/globals.css.

font.font-sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
font.font-mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
font.font-serif: Georgia, "Iowan Old Style", "Times New Roman", ui-serif, serif
